name: simple-server
description: Zero-dependency Node static server for a single-page app: secure paths, compression, caching, SPA fallback, PWA-ready. 100/100 Lighthouse out of the box.

scripts.cert: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 825 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -subj /CN=localhost -addext subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1
